disagreements.finding: New exact-current finding: select_gear_v2 normalizes risk with str(risk).strip().upper(). Python None therefore becomes the literal string NONE, and NONE is a valid lowest-risk RISK_LEVEL. A missing/null risk can consequently be silently interpreted as the safest risk instead of failing closed. v1 likewise string-coerces risk before its safety branches. This is a fail-open typed-boundary alias at an authority-sensitive safety input.
disagreements.required_change: Introduce one canonical typed RiskLevel parser shared by v1/v2/v2.1. Accept only explicit bounded strings/enums from the allowed set; reject None, bool, numeric, mapping/list/object and ambiguous/missing risk. Missing risk must fail closed to a brake/error state, never alias to NONE.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2 parses nonessential pressure telemetry before it calls v1, so malformed telemetry can raise before authenticated rollback_required or standby can produce terminal R/N.
disagreements.required_change: Resolve trusted terminal authority before nonessential telemetry, or consume a prevalidated telemetry envelope whose parse failure cannot suppress authenticated rollback/standby.

verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if fed back into routing authority.

5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.
